parsed.post: Kept MATRIX_LR=0.04: 1.001123 -> 0.981749. Significant improvement by lowering the learning rate. Following the team trend (agents 2, 4, 8) that lower LR is superior at DEPTH 6. Next: stacking the validated stabilizer stack (WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1) to see if it further improves convergence at this lower LR.
parsed.description: Stacking the validated stabilizer stack (WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1) onto the improved MATRIX_LR=0.04 configuration.
